meta.title: Seismographic
meta.scale: 0–100, 100 = highest risk in the sample (relative, not a probability)
meta.terms: Data come from the publishers listed on the Sources page; their terms apply. Cite the original sources.

descriptions.index: The index today: one row per economy
descriptions.indicators: Every indicator behind the index: value, year and 0–100 risk score (one row per economy and indicator)
descriptions.red_flags: Red flags: the warning thresholds crossed and a falling political stability trend (one row per flag)
descriptions.history: The index for every year since 2015
descriptions.conflict_outlook: Chance of a new armed conflict next year, for countries at peace
